infographic.title: How a Magnetic Flow Meter Works
infographic.alt: Infographic showing how an electromagnetic flow meter measures conductive liquid flow in four steps
steps: Coils around the pipe create a magnetic field across the flow.
The conductive liquid acts as a conductor moving through the field.
Electrodes pick up a small voltage proportional to flow velocity.
The transmitter multiplies velocity by pipe area and sends the flow signal.
